text:
Elena: Quick sync — Zephyr private VPC change window is set for Tue 03/28 22:00 PDT. Need: primary deploy owner, secondary, smoke test owner, rollback owner. Target duration 60m. Can folks claim roles? :calendar:

Mike: I can be primary deploy. Will be on-call.

Sam: I’ll be secondary + will monitor logs/metrics (Grafana alerting ready).

Ingrid: QA will run smoke; I’ll own the smoke checklist. Is there a staging preview URL we can use?

Elena: Staging preview: https://zephyr-staging.internal/ (creds in 1Password, path: Team/Zephyr). Smoke checklist (short):
• health endpoint
• auth login flow
• basic /v1/generate endpoint
• DB migration sanity (no schema drift)
I'll paste the quick commands below.

Elena: Smoke commands:
```sh
# health
TOKEN=$(secret-tool get zephyr/token)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://zephyr-staging.internal/v1/health | jq .status

# simple generation
curl -s -X POST https://zephyr-staging.internal/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq .output
```

qa-bot: Automated smoke runner scheduled at 2024-03-28T21:30:00-07:00 (30m before window) — results will be posted here.

Mike: Rollback plan proposal: switch traffic to fallback model pool + apply previous infra revision. Rollback owner?

Sam: I'll own rollback. Steps I'll follow: 1) set traffic_weight to previous config in module zephyr_traffic, 2) `terraform apply -var='revision=prev'` from infra/zephyr, 3) verify health endpoints, 4) notify team. Aim to have rollback ready within 20m.

deploy-bot: Reserved maintenance slot created: 2024-03-28 22:00-23:00 PDT for Zephyr private VPC (owner: Mike). Reminder scheduled 1h before.

Ingrid: I'll run manual smoke at T+10m post-cutover and post results as a short checklist (pass/fail + any errors). If failure, escalate to Sam immediately and trigger rollback within 20m.

Elena: Can someone confirm DB migration is already applied and reversible in staging? @Mike

Mike: Verified migrations are applied in staging and reversible. We have a pg_dump snapshot id s-20240328-01 in backups. Also validated a migration rollback path in the migration repo.

Elena: Great. I'll post the final preflight checklist 2 hours before the window and pin it here. Please ack roles so we can close the loop.

Sam: Acknowledged. :white_check_mark:

Mike: Acknowledged. :thumbsup:

Ingrid: Acknowledged, will watch the thread during the window.

Elena: Thanks all — I'll follow up with the pinned checklist and a quick playbook (smoke + rollback commands) before EOD.
